title: Embracer Group to Spin Off Fellowship Entertainment With Dark Horse Media
content: The board of directors for Dark Horse Media's parent company Embracer Group announced on Wednesday that it intends to split the group into two publicly listed companies, through the spinoff of Fellowship Entertainment.

title: Three Years Ago, Dragon Ball Z Set a Record It’s Never Going to Break
content: Dragon Ball Z is one of the most iconic anime series out there. Its imagery and lore are (by this point) so well-known all over the world that the series routinely brings in new fans who have never actually seen a single episode of the anime.

title: Anime Expo Hosts Musical Artists ALI, Yōko Kanno
content: Anime Expo announced on Monday that artists ALI and Yōko Kanno will also perform at the J-POP SOUND CAPSULE @ AX 2026 music concert, completing the lineup. The concert also features girl group Roselia , rock band SPYAIR , and singer Yoko Takahashi . J-POP SOUND CAPSULE @ AX 2026 will be held on July 2 from 8:00 p.m.

title: Delicious in Dungeon, Ryoko Kui Exhibition Hits Los Angeles on July 2
content: Kadokawa World Entertainment announced on Wednesday that the official " Ryōko Kui Exhibition" and " Delicious in Dungeon Exhibition" will open in Los Angeles on July 2 and run through July 26. The exhibition will take place at Art Share L.A., 801 E 4th Place, Los Angeles, CA 90013.
